sourceLibrary.referencePolicy: Command & Conquer 3: Tiberium Wars, Supreme Commander 2, XCOM 2 and StarCraft II guide only broad readability, hierarchy, scale and pacing. Never copy or trace protected models, maps, materials, silhouettes, symbols, organisms, palettes or named landmarks; every source must remain original MASSFRONT work with provenance.

generationPolicy.originalityBoundary: Generated concepts establish original MASSFRONT art direction only. Hunyuan source meshes must not reproduce protected designs, and exported source masters require topology, scale, UV, material, collision, LOD, mobile-capture and runtime review before any catalog admission.

firstWave.strategy: Generate one identity-defining Hunyuan source master for every planet before expanding any planet into a large kit; this bounds review load while proving all 32 biome and faction languages.

expansionRules.action: enqueue the same planet across its five missing asset categories using its indexed site prompts
constraints: retain the planet biomeKey and factionContexts
require a separately approved concept for every new Hunyuan source
never count palette swaps as a new model

expansionRules.trigger: two category sources for a planet reach SOURCE_VERIFIED
expansionRules.action: enqueue one seed for each uncovered location class before producing cosmetic variants
constraints: use the exact indexed siteId and prompt section
preserve combined-arms gates routes and objective courts
do not clone another planet layout

expansionRules.trigger: a hero_building or skyscraper source reaches SOURCE_VERIFIED
expansionRules.action: derive a coherent socket-tested kit of podium roads corners junctions tunnels endcaps and damage states
constraints: snap exterior modules to the 4 m and 16 m grids
roads and towers must tile into believable districts
derived runtime meshes retain the Hunyuan source and concept provenance

expansionRules.action: author companion props and assemble a minimum 96 by 96 meter combined-arms interior test layout
constraints: retain an 18 by 8 meter small-vehicle gate
support soldiers small vehicles and mechs rather than soldier-only corridors
publish collision cover LOS roof-cutaway and portal proxies

expansionRules.trigger: a planet includes brood_hostile faction context
expansionRules.action: enqueue hostile non-humanoid invasion contact and consumed-structure sources as removable stages
constraints: Brood is never a playable humanoid faction
keep clean settlement geometry as a separate source
adapt infestation contact to local geology and ecology

expansionRules.trigger: a source export and its pack companions pass source verification
expansionRules.action: create a separate runtime-candidate task without changing this source queue status
constraints: require matched phone-first captures and hashes
require triangle texture collision navigation and destruction budgets
close the finished saved and exported Spline tab before opening the next source document
